environment.description: Node.js 18 Apollo Server 4.x deployed behind an nginx reverse proxy (v1.21) with default proxy_pass configuration. nginx uses HTTP/1.1 keepalive to the upstream Node process. No request normalization or header sanitization is applied. The /playground endpoint is publicly accessible. CSP header is not set. nginx config: proxy_pass http://node_upstream; proxy_http_version 1.1; proxy_set_header Connection '';

config.proxy: nginx:1.21 with default proxy_pass, keepalive enabled
